>

Updates an existing asset audit policy configuration. This endpoint allows modification of all policy settings including policy type, name, description, target asset groups, verification schedules, alert notification settings, and assigned auditors or teams. The update operation replaces the policy configuration with the provided values while preserving the policy's ID and historical data.

**Prerequisites:**
- Asset Audit Policy ID must be obtained from [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)
- Asset Audit Policy Type ID can be obtained from [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies/types](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policy-types)

**Workflow Example:**
1. List all policies: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policies)
2. Extract the target policy's `AssetAuditPolicyId` from `Items[].AssetAuditPolicyId`
3. Optionally get current policy details: [GET /api/v1.0/audits/policies/\{AssetAuditPolicyId\}](/docs/api/audits/get-asset-audit-policy)
4. Prepare the updated policy configuration in the request body
5. Update the policy using this endpoint

**Minimal Required Fields:**
The request body must include all required fields from the UpdateAssetAuditPolicyRequest schema: Name and AssetAuditPolicyTypeId at minimum.
